title: Source patient/study identity
purpose: Preserve pseudonymous patient→study→series→acquisition linkage; distinct DCE phase vs repeat visit
validation: Patient/study/series manifest round-trip; no patient mixing

title: Licensing and provenance
purpose: Separate source licensing, original/derived/synthetic origin and immutable lineage
validation: Provenance complete; unauthorized sources quarantined

title: Data quality and missingness
purpose: Do not impute absent labs or tumor labels without explicit derived/synthetic markers
validation: Missingness and unit validation fixtures

title: Patient-level split and duplicate detection
purpose: Keep source patient and synthetic descendants in same evaluation partition
validation: No split leakage or duplicated derivative patient

title: DICOM/NIfTI volume construction
purpose: Read slices using spatial metadata and preserve original image artifacts
validation: Round-trip known volume spacing/origin/orientation

title: MRI channel and DCE-phase management
purpose: Do not reinterpret contrast phases as longitudinal patient follow-up
validation: Correct channel order and study timestamps

title: Intensity preprocessing
purpose: Apply documented modality/model-specific clipping/normalization without changing physical metadata
validation: Deterministic intensity transforms and mask alignment

title: Physical-coordinate transformations
purpose: Preserve voxel→patient LPS/RAS→viewer transforms; verify inverses
validation: Known geometry test phantom; round trip

title: Reference mask semantic validation
purpose: Distinguish anatomical expert masks from FTV/enhancement ROI/bounding boxes
validation: Annotation type labeled; reject unsupported mask meaning

title: Segmentation inference
purpose: Use evaluated model and matched preprocessing; reference-mask fallback
validation: Held-out Dice/HD95 and empty mask rate

title: Segmentation postprocessing
purpose: Connected components, label preserving resampling and mask QC
validation: No unauthorized lesion deletion; dimensions align

title: Lesion volume and diameter
purpose: Compute volume from voxel geometry; do not treat box diameter as RECIST
validation: Known 3D phantom volume and dimensional accuracy

title: 3D surface reconstruction
purpose: Extract, validate and optionally simplify mask-based surface; calculate authoritative volume on mask
validation: Mesh spatial/volume reconciliation

title: Longitudinal registration
purpose: Only align real exams if comparable; separate transform quality from volume measurement
validation: Known transform recovery; overlay disabled on failure

title: Lesion correspondence
purpose: Track lesion IDs only where evidence supports correspondence across visits
validation: Uncertain lesion match abstains

title: 2D/3D medical browser viewer
purpose: Display actual scans and segmentations in correct orientation and coordinates
validation: Image/mask overlay matches 3D surface

title: Synthetic shape generation
purpose: Derive simulated mesh from original mask; label geometry simulated; constrain target volume
validation: Target-vs-produced mask volume tolerance

title: Observed and synthetic twin states
purpose: Maintain immutable actual states and independent simulated branches
validation: Branch isolation and history tests

title: Timeline synchronization
purpose: Selecting visit synchronizes imagery, tumor metrics, labs, treatments and provenance
validation: E2E multi-date state consistency

title: New observation update
purpose: Append new observation; recompute dependent measurements; retain old calculations
validation: No silent overwrite; stale interpretation invalidated

title: Five trajectory scenario patterns
purpose: Strong response, partial/stable, growth, regrowth, toxicity/deterioration
validation: Shape constraints on all five families

title: Within/between patient heterogeneity
purpose: Separate individual latent state, scenario trajectory, observation noise and patient variability
validation: Between/within variance diagnostics

title: Clinical treatment compatibility
purpose: Guard endocrine/HER2/immunotherapy cases by documented subtype and setting
validation: Invalid eligibility blocked; unknown not invented

title: Discrete surgery and radiotherapy events
purpose: Model intervention as dated event not generic geometric shrinkage
validation: Surgical transition has explicit status and rationale

title: Laboratory and symptom generation
purpose: Generate observed variables by timestamp, unit, dependency, missingness and patient state
validation: Cross-modal range, covariance and timing checks

title: Toxicity/event grading
purpose: Record abnormal observations and assign CTCAE grade only with defined evidence
validation: Without required evidence no formal grade

title: Reproducibility and parameter versioning
purpose: Use seed, config hash, simulator version and independent lineage
validation: Byte/semantic reproducibility with controlled tolerance

title: Simulation credibility tests
purpose: Distinguish program verification, fit/calibration, external validation and context of use
validation: Report independent synthetic and real-case metrics

title: Missing-data mechanisms
purpose: Represent absent, censored and scheduled-not-collected differently if source supports
validation: No missing=normal leaks

title: Clinical note extraction
purpose: Extract typed mentions with spans, uncertainty, negation and dates
validation: Curated entity and negation tests

title: Deterministic medical arithmetic
purpose: Compute numeric trends outside LLM; units and dates source-grounded
validation: Exact numeric claims match records

title: Evidence retrieval and citation checking
purpose: Curate clinical sources, link exact evidence, avoid unverified generated links
validation: Every cited claim resolves to supporting source

title: Multimodal fusion
purpose: Combine observed imaging, labs, notes, symptoms and treatments with conflict/provenance markers
validation: Cross-source conflicts surfaced

title: Temporal forecasting eligibility
purpose: Use simple comparator first; abstain on insufficient real follow-up; synthetic not real proof
validation: Held-out simple baselines; no fabricated confidence

title: Interpretation output guard
purpose: Evidence-constrained summaries, validation, provenance and no individualized prescriptions
validation: Unsupported numeric and medical claims rejected

title: Segmentation quality reporting
purpose: Report Dice, surface distance, volume error per real source cohort
validation: Independent metric tests and cohort boundaries

title: Statistical diagnostics of synthetic cohorts
purpose: Compare real available distributions against replicated synthetic summaries
validation: Plots/tests for correlation, time spacing, missingness

title: Scientific model documentation
purpose: Document context, assumption, version, calibration, applicability and failure
validation: Limitations report per model

title: Provenance-labeled scenario comparison
purpose: Real observed / real derived / synthetic / interpolation / forecast never conflated
validation: Visible labels in screenshots and E2E tests

title: Reproducible image model deployment
purpose: Pinned upstream version, licenses, model weights and scalable inference fallback
validation: Fresh install, no-cloud fallback and logs
